title: Titans Championship Prep - Training Schedule
content: The Titans have intensified their training sessions with two-a-days on Mondays and Wednesdays focusing on endurance and strength. Special attention is being given to strategic plays and teamwork during the Thursday and Friday sessions.

title: Mike Henderson's Recovery Plan
content: Mike Henderson is on a strict recovery plan following his hamstring injury. The plan includes daily physiotherapy, a modified diet to promote healing, and a gradual reintroduction to training, aiming for a return to full fitness before the championship game.

title: Titans vs. Falcons - Game Strategy
content: The game plan against the Falcons includes a focus on exploiting their weak defense on the right flank and maintaining possession to control the pace of the game. There is an emphasis on quick passes and agility training to counter the Falcons' slower midfielders.
